verdict.rationale: Graphite Chat on the PR page answers questions with context: it explains changes, answers targeted questions on highlighted diff lines, helps you understand reviewer feedback, and applies suggested fixes or makes agent commits from the PR page. However, this happens in a side chat panel and agent pane, and nothing shows a developer replying directly to Graphite Agent's review comments in the PR thread. Missing for 10: evidence of in-thread replies to AI review comments with conversational responses, comment-based commands to the reviewer, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
